I wish I had started sooner. Thanks to the northtown staff for your support and help! I am able to live life and do the things I love.

reviews.title: Poor Beginning
reviews.text: Mixed communication, issues with account set-up, borderline rude customer service, problem was resolved eventually but it took a lot of time and frustration to get there.  And no one seemed to care how I felt about it or receptive of feedback back as it was all corporate and they had no control.  Very bad start with a new customer even with some concessions made. I felt talked down to and made to feel this was my fault and I’m learning YOUR business and tools. I liked the two visits I’ve had and the people but the business side and customer service could use some development.

reviews.title: Great for people with neurological issues
reviews.text: I have Multiple sclerosis. I am spastic in the back of my legs. I have had a stroke and it made things more challenging. I do pilates daily. I was having difficulty holding my legs at 90 degrees. Assisted stretching h made it all work together.

reviews.title: Celibacy…
reviews.text: This is perfect for people who are celibate we no longer use the muscles we used to when we were “active” and these ASSISTED stretches are a great reminder of how “limber” we used to be 😜😳😩☺️

reviews.title: Improved quality of life
reviews.text: At 65, after multiple bouts of cancer and joint replacements, my quality of life was severely diminished. Since going to StretchLab, I have experienced a dramatic improvement in the level of daily pain, a definite increase in mobility and a general overall feeling of happiness. I cannot provide enough positive feedback for the professional group of people who work there and the cleanliness and comfort of the room. I strongly recommend StretchLab to anyone regardless of age or mobility. A definite value for the cost.

While living in Pennsylvania i found a great gym that offered FST as an optional service and experienced the benefits first hand, but when I moved back to Ohio I stopped because it wasn’t available to me…. Until I found StretchLab. I would I highly HIGHLY recommend yo give this a chance!

reviews.title: Stretches are good, sales need improvement
reviews.text:
The actual stretches are great- they've helped reduce pain in my muscles caused by lack of activity. 

The sales team needs to improve.  I've been given incorrect information multiple times which has caused me to lose credits which is equivalent loss in the hundreds of dollars.  I was told unused monthly credits roll into the next month - which is not true because they do not roll unless you speak to someone and request them be rolled.  Then found out they don't all roll and only a limited number roll.   Another time Iwas told the credits i purchased did not expire - to later find out they did.   I  also i had to tell the sales people to stop calling to either sell me new credits or schedule appointments.  The frequency of calls were excessive.

reviews.title: Best Investment in Myself
reviews.text: For more than a year, my weekly stretches have proven to be one of the best investments in my physical & emotional health. Together, Alain & I have crafted a flexible routine which targets the weaker areas,  avoids the critical zones while intermittently maintaining total body flexibility.

reviews.title: Takes days to log in
reviews.text: When I open the app, I have to log in everytime. It never accepts my password so I have to through the password reset process everytime. The link takes about 30 minutes to appear in my email. Then when it finally arrives and change my password, the password is rejected because the link expired. This process is continued constantly until I finally get logged in. To summarize it takes days to log in everytime.

reviews.title: Willard Blair Kalthoff
reviews.text:
I had a cranial aneurysm (07-21)and was paralyzed on my left side. I have managed to lose the hospital bed, wheelchair, walker. My nest goal is to lose the cane.

*This has been the hardest assistance tool to have give up or lose.  I am seeing a major difference in my strength and walking ability since joining stretchLab.  My goal is to eventually return to light jogging and continue to work out as much as possible which at this time is seven days a week some days medium to very light,  Somedays treadmill and bike only.  StretchLab has given me back my confidence, that I will be able to return to normal activity in the future.  I recommend anyone with an ailment, give Stretch Lab serious consideration. everyone has been very professional while maintaining their good senses of humor with me, by the grace of God, I will walk without assistance.

reviews.title: “It’s currently not possible to book this stretch”
reviews.text: Whatever upgrade was done is a hot mess. I can no longer book stretches via the app. I have logged out, logged back in, deleted the app, reloaded the app. My flexologist says I’m not the only one with this issue.  Figure it out.

reviews.title: Unreliable, Expensive, and Poor Customer Suport
reviews.text: The stetching itself was nice - a bit expensive overall in my opinion.  But the location where I signed up was really unreliable.  They weren’t able to post schedules to the app and advised me to call or come in to schedule, but several times when I tried to stop in during what should have been normal business hours they were closed and no one answered the phone.  And the ‘flexologists’ would turn over every other week.  I paid close to $600 for 3 months (4x25 min sessions per month) and I wasn’t even able to use the last month.  Now I guess they ‘got’ me with an auto-renewal at a higher price because even though my card expired they sent me an email saying that I owe them $194.  What a headache.  I suggest just doing some yoga instead.
